headline: Executive order sets rules for the Presidential Management Fellows Program, a federal government career program.
what_it_does: This order deals with the Presidential Management Fellows Program, which places people in jobs at federal agencies. Only the title was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here. The program is generally known as a way for recent graduate-degree holders to start careers in the federal government.

who_it_affects.group: Recent graduate students seeking federal jobs
who_it_affects.how: The order sets the terms of a program that offers them a path into federal government careers.
Agencies that take part would hire and train fellows under the program's rules.
